$help: SEO monitor config. interval: weekly (Mondays) | 10days (1st, 11th, 21st) | 15days (1st, 16th) | monthly (1st). Dates are in `timezone`. thresholds are floors per device: a score below them is a regression. dropTolerance: how many points a score may fall since the last run before it counts as a regression (lab scores vary run to run).
